messages:
Anika: Morning team — brought waffles but labeled them `v0.9.1-alpha` so they could be spicy. 😂
Jon: That versioning is wild. I bumped my cereal today to `1.0.0` and it refused to run without milk.
Priya: YAML update from the kitchen: apparently the syrup config needs a trailing quote to unlock breakfast features.
Anika: Also FYI the toaster returned: "error: undefined butter reference". Would like a PR to fix ASAP.
Jon: Opening PR: `fix(toast): add butter reference and docs` — target: main.
Priya: Please don't semver my pancakes. We agreed on stability guarantees. :pleading_face:
ops-bot: Reminder — kitchen_policy_v1.0.0 is deprecated, migrating to kitchen_policy_v2beta this week. See https://intra/kitchen/policies :robot_face:
Jon: Quick reproducible snippet causing the YAML cry:
```yaml
pancakes:
  batter: true
  syrup: "optional
  eggs: 2
```
Priya: Missing quote -> YAML throws a tantrum. Classic. :crying_cat_face:
Anika: This feels like the compiler error I got yesterday: "cannot infer whether toast is bread or breadish".
Jon: Vote time: maple vs agnostic syrup? React with :maple_leaf: for maple, :milk_glass: for agnostic.
Priya: I'll tally in 2h. Also bonus meme: sticker on the coffee machine says "I optimize what I cannot understand" — that's our runtime team. :coffee:
Anika: Whoever writes the release notes for breakfast, please include migration guide: "How to handle breaking changes when your pancake stack disallows butter".
Jon: :thumbsup:
Priya: closing poll in 2h — may the best syrup win.
